name: astral-orchestrator
description: Beginner-friendly orchestration with Quick, Guided, Careful, Measured, and explicit opt-in Morph and Constellation modes for planning, delegating, verifying, and reviewing project work in Codex.

interface.shortDescription: Simple, risk-aware delivery for any project.
interface.longDescription: Astral Orchestrator offers Quick, Guided, Careful, Measured, Morph, and Constellation modes with table-form live status. On current Codex hosts, Guided, Careful, and Measured use native MultiAgentsV2 workers explicitly pinned to Luna Max or Terra High by default and a fresh Sol High reviewer; configured efforts remain independently adjustable. Morph and Constellation stay explicit opt-ins; each explicit opt-in mode never runs automatically.
defaultPrompt: Use Astral Orchestrator in Guided mode (default); choose Quick or Careful when the task warrants it.
Use Astral Orchestrator in Measured or Morph mode for this explicit opt-in request.
Use Astral Orchestrator in Constellation mode for this explicit opt-in independent-card request.
